name: Matsuzaki Shuzo
about: Matsuzaki Shuzo was founded in 1892 in Tenei, a small rice growing village in Fukushima, and its history starts with Matsuzaki Shichinosuke, who ran a koji shop. Its brand Hirotogawa takes its name from Hirotogawa, the old name of the nearby Shakado River.

For most of its history it sold only locally, and it began national distribution in 2011. Most of its sake uses Yume no Ka, a Fukushima brewing rice developed in 2000, grown mainly around Tenei. The water is medium hard well water from the grounds, and the sixth generation head also serves as toji.
